in_sanskrit.name: आरिया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is virtuous, noble, and honourable.

in_marathi.name: Ariya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ariya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, the name Ariya means 'Lady' or 'Princess'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ari', which means 'ruler' or 'king'. In Hindu mythology, Ariya is also the name of a goddess who represents prosperity and abundance.
